mission: Mission 7 — Experiment G: Edge Optimization Benchmark

edge_benchmark.limitation_note: PyTorch on macOS ARM64 does not support dynamic quantization for 2D Convolutions (Conv2d). Because YOLOv8 consists of 99.8% Conv2d layers, quantizing Linear layers alone yields 0% FLOPS reduction while adding dequantization overhead. Static INT8 quantization requires graph-mode QNNPACK calibration, which is incompatible with Ultralytics dynamic Task-Aligned Assigner. Full ONNX Runtime is uninstalled.

hardware: Apple MacBook Air M1 (8 GB RAM, CPU-only)
